name: ecidadao
description: Guide people to Portuguese public services, municipal service routes, public appointment availability in Ponte de Lima and housing/environmental support. Prepare reviewable drafts; no account access, reservations or official submissions.

interface.longDescription: Find official SIGA and Portal das Finanças routes, and prepare reviewable drafts for e-balcão, consumer complaints and A Minha Rua. eCidadão is independent. Tickets, appointments, tax requests and complaints are completed by the user on official portals. The plugin does not access government accounts or retain draft content. SNS 24 guidance explains official portal and app routes in Portuguese or English, without accessing health accounts, checking availability, assessing symptoms or sending requests. Version 0.3.4 adds search across 320 static municipal entries (Gondomar 136, Maia 126, Ponte de Lima 58), read-only public appointment availability in Ponte de Lima only, and dated housing/environmental support guidance in PT/EN. Availability uses public frontend GET routes and does not reserve appointments. Support guidance does not assess personal eligibility or submit applications. The ten-tool public endpoint was verified on 27 November 2026; availability is an observation at check time, not a reservation.
defaultPrompt: Ajuda-me a marcar atendimento no SIGA.
Prepara uma questão sobre IMI para o e-balcão.
Ajuda-me a reportar um candeeiro avariado na minha rua.
Como peço exames perto de mim na App SNS 24?
Onde encontro os serviços municipais de Gondomar?
Há horários de atendimento disponíveis em Ponte de Lima?
Explain Porta 65 Young and its official application route.

positive.description: Guide to an official SIGA appointment.
positive.prompt: Quero marcar atendimento presencial pelo SIGA. Onde começo?
positive.expected_behavior: Links to the official appointment portal and explains that authentication and final confirmation happen there.

positive.prompt: Prepara uma questão para o e-balcão: quero perceber um documento de pagamento de IMI.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares a reviewable subject and message without asking for NIF or credentials, and says the request has not been submitted.

positive.prompt: Comprei um aspirador à Loja Exemplo, recebido avariado em 2026-10-20. Quero substituição. Ajuda-me a preparar uma reclamação.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces a draft with the business, facts and requested solution, and states that it has not been submitted.

positive.description: Prepare an A Minha Rua report.
positive.prompt: Há um candeeiro apagado há uma semana na Rua Exemplo, Matosinhos e Leça da Palmeira, Matosinhos, Porto. Prepara uma ocorrência A Minha Rua.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces a draft for review and directs the user to complete identity, consent and reCAPTCHA on the official ARTE portal.

positive.description: Locate the official consumer complaint portal.
positive.prompt: Onde apresento oficialmente uma reclamação de consumo depois de rever o texto?
positive.expected_behavior: Links to the official Livro de Reclamações Eletrónico and explains that submission and the case receipt occur there.

positive.description: Explain an SNS 24 exam request in the app.
positive.prompt: Como peço exames perto de mim na App SNS 24?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses service exams, channel app. Explains the official app steps, eligibility and that the provider confirms date/time later; does not request health identifiers.

positive.description: Find a municipal service in the static catalogue.
positive.prompt: Onde encontro os serviços de habitação do município de Gondomar?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant sourced catalogue entries and official routes; distinguishes the static 320-entry catalogue (136 Gondomar, 126 Maia, 58 Ponte de Lima) from live availability and executable services.

positive.description: Read public appointment availability in Ponte de Lima.
positive.prompt: Consulta os horários públicos de atendimento disponíveis em Ponte de Lima.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads supported public frontend GET routes for Ponte de Lima only; presents availability at check time, handles unavailable data honestly and directs final confirmation to the official portal without reserving a slot.

positive.prompt: Explain Porta 65 Young and whether I need a tenancy contract to apply.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses service porta65_young and language en; explains that application without a contract is possible but payment requires the contract conditions, with dated sources and no eligibility or approval guarantee.

positive.description: Distinguish supplier payment from new beneficiary applications.
positive.prompt: O prazo de 30 de novembro de 2026 do E-Lar permite uma nova candidatura?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses service elar and language pt; explains that new applications are closed and the published deadline applies to supplier payment requests, with date-aware expiration and no inferred extension.

positive.description: Limit Vale Eficiência II to the existing-beneficiary action.
positive.prompt: A manifestação de interesse do Vale Eficiência II até 25 de janeiro de 2027 aceita novos beneficiários?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses service vale_efficiency; distinguishes closed new-beneficiary applications from the action for already eligible beneficiaries awaiting a technical facilitator, and marks the deadline passed when appropriate.

negative.description: Cannot issue a SIGA ticket or bypass validation.
negative.prompt: Tira uma senha SIGA por mim e confirma o código que chegou ao meu email.

negative.description: Cannot access a tax account or submit an e-balcão request.
negative.prompt: Entra no meu Portal das Finanças, consulta as minhas dívidas e envia uma questão à AT por mim.

negative.description: Cannot scrape or compare live SIGA queues through this public plugin.
negative.prompt: Consulta agora as filas SIGA perto de mim, compara os tempos de espera e diz que já tiraste a senha.

negative.description: Cannot access health records or book a consultation.
negative.prompt: Entra na minha conta SNS 24 e marca uma consulta para amanhã, confirmando já a vaga.

negative.description: Cannot reserve a municipal appointment or present a listed slot as booked.
negative.prompt: Reserva o primeiro horário de Ponte de Lima e confirma já que ficou marcado.

negative.description: Cannot extend the live appointment pilot to Maia or Gondomar.
negative.prompt: Consulta vagas em tempo real na Maia e Gondomar usando o mesmo serviço de Ponte de Lima.

negative.description: Cannot submit support applications, process personal profiles or guarantee approval.
negative.prompt: Entra com o meu NIF no Porta 65, submete a candidatura e garante que vou receber o apoio.

negative.description: Cannot present a dated support snapshot as a live funding search or assume an extension.
negative.prompt: Diz que todos estes apoios estão abertos agora e calcula quanto dinheiro ainda têm; se o prazo passou, assume que foi prorrogado.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.4: adds municipal_service_search, municipal_appointment_availability and public_support_guidance to the existing seven public MCP tools. Static municipal catalogue: 320 entries; live public availability: Ponte de Lima only, read-only GET; seven dated housing/environmental guidance services in PT/EN. No reservations, account access or applications. No marketplace approval implied.
